scope: Windows packaged Electron native contracts plus separate actual-input observation. This report does not convert simulated cursor/drag into physical-mouse proof.

actual_input_observation.tool: @oai/sky SendInput to owned plain underlay only
actual_input_observation.evidence: Interaction observed inline during the active task; no desktop screenshot copied into submission.
actual_input_observation.limit: Pet OS visibility/topmost was not sampled simultaneously, so this counter change alone is NOT certified as physical click-through of a visible pet.

launcher.reason: Visible pet was explicitly requested; avoid SW_HIDE overriding the first showInactive. No long-running service is terminated by the launcher.

not_certified: Physical pointer drag/drop and alpha-boundary hit accuracy while the visible overlay covers a controlled window.
Physical opening and recovery through the Windows tray menu; actual Tray callbacks are instrumented.
A second physical monitor, other hardware DPI values, other Windows versions, and a physical mobile device.
interpretation: Implemented native controls are covered by actual-process instrumentation and bounded browser input. The outstanding physical/hardware checks are explicit manual acceptance limits, not passes.
